author: Unique Research
html:
Within just 22 days of its mobile launch (January 15, 2025), DeepSeek's DAU exceeded 40 million, accounting for 74.30% of ChatGPT's mobile DAU (54.95 million) on the same day（February 5, 2025).

A week earlier (January 29, 2025), DeepSeek's mobile DAU stood at 20.8 million, meaning it doubled within a week.

Within just 22 days of its mobile launch (January 15, 2025), DeepSeek's DAU exceeded 40 million, accounting for 74.30% of ChatGPT's mobile DAU (54.95 million) on the same day（February 5, 2025).

A week earlier (January 29, 2025), DeepSeek's mobile DAU stood at 20.8 million, meaning it doubled within a week.
title: DeepSeek's mobile app has surpassed 40 million daily active users (DAU).
